bug.description: The "/" mount, now the last route, breaks tests/api/test_errors.py::test_unhandled_exception_500_does_not_leak. That test registers /_boom with @app.get at test time, so it lands after the catch-all StaticFiles mount and is shadowed (404 instead of 500). Fix is on the test side, e.g. insert the temp route before the mount, or remove/restore the mount around it. Criterion 5 forbids unrelated edits, so the implementer must decide how to do this minimally. Production behavior is unaffected.
